supports: The Arboretum has seven different hiking trails and 13 distinct ecosystems.
The Arboretum covers 136 acres.
The Arboretum is open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with last entry at 4:30 p.m.

editorial.hook: Seven trails through 13 ecosystems on a 136-acre Jacksonville reserve
editorial.why_here: The Jacksonville Arboretum & Botanical Gardens is a nonprofit reserve with trails, curated gardens and community events. Its landscape includes freshwater and tidal marshes, hardwood forests, pine flatwoods and live oak hammocks.

editorial.local_tip: Allow time for multiple trails, since the site covers seven trails across 13 ecosystems.
editorial.best_time: Go in the morning for quieter trails before the 4:30 p.m. last entry.
